items.prompt: The accumulated signed cash total is -105 cents. Which formatting rule produces the required output?

options.text: Separate the sign, then format abs(total) as 1.05.
options.why: The result is -1.05; magnitude division/remainder keep both fractional digits correct.

options.text: Use total//100 and total%100 directly as -2.95.
options.why: Python floors the negative quotient; those pieces do not represent the decimal magnitude.
That changes a loss into a gain.

options.text: Print -1.5 because the last two digits are 5.
options.why: Cents need two fractional digits, so five cents is 05.

items.explanation: The result is -1.05; magnitude division/remainder keep both fractional digits correct.
